author: Whatfinger
title: Pakistan investigates deadly tutoring center roof collapse in Lahore | DW News
text:
Families in Lahore are mourning 14 children killed when the roof of a tutoring center collapsed during class. Witnesses describe frantic rescue efforts as residents joined emergency workers to search through the rubble. Authorities have arrested two people and launched an investigation into whether negligence played a role. The tragedy is raising broader concerns about safety standards in schools and tutoring center across Pakistan.
